main_text.p: oleum scripto mandauit. Calechutani laste[?] cybu-tyro vefcuntur, panesq; factitant fine frumer[?] toin foco tantū cocłos &c cinere. Oryza apud eos abun-dantia summa, eaq; cymbalis, faltationib. omniq; laetitiæ genere ferunt, damonia sua pręcātes vt sit oryzæ vberrimus prouentus, hæc n. varias epulas conficiunt, ex palmis potant liquoré, carnibus pi-scibusq; promiscuè vescuntur, à bubalatamè absti-nent, boues namq; sacrofanctos putant. Quicolunt Infulā, quæ S. Iohannis porta dicta est, canes alit saginantq; in vsum cibarii, verum nullus illis la-tratus est, rostrumq; habent vulpinū. Infima plebs piscatu nutritur, muriumq; venatu. Mameluchi, qui Sultano parebant Ægyptio, equorū, camelo-rū, bubalorū, carnib. vtilis ārunt. Arietes in illis locis grandes & memorabiles vsuntur magnitudi-ne asinos æquantes, quorū aliqui cauda gestant li-brarū 40. adeò obesi vt pꝓgredi[?] vix valeant: capras præterea grandes illic reperiri traditur, quæ vno partu quatuor hœdos enitantur. Apud quasdā O-rientiū gentes sunt gallinæ, quæ pro pennis pilos ge-rant nigricantes, quib. vescuntur, pariterq; ipsarū carnes q; sunt saporis suauissimi. Liquores ex sau-ciatis arboribus emanantes in potum assumunt: quin & sub earum corticibus farinā reperiri præ-dicāt, q; præbeat incolis pulmēta suauiāq; cibaria. Pygmei, (quorum tota cohors cubito non est al-tior vno, vt ait Iuuenalis) pro frugib. aduerso gru-es dimicabant: nā & tantillos homunculos mitio-ribus alimentis vti natura docuit: fabulosam aute[?]

page.notes: Right-hand lower mark after the last line is uncertain and may be an ornament or catchword; it is marked [?] above. "Calechutani laste[?] cybu-" and "factitant fine frumer[?] toin" are difficult; the marked words are doubtful. "pꝓgredi[?]" has an unclear abbreviation over the p. The final word "aute[?]" is cut off at the edge of the scan. The "&c" after "cocłos" is printed as a ligature and is transcribed as "&c".
